With the British invasion, India got tea
plantation and even today India is known
for its tea export.

India is the largest democratic country in the
world demonstrating unity among diversity
of various languages, castes, creed, religions,
cultures, traditions and so on.

Before the British period India was known to
have been rich in agriculture, industry and
civilization.

India has a unique identity with rich cultural
diversity.

Economic concept of the ancient India :

India was extremely prosperous and known
for agriculture, traditional crafts and trade.

( 1 ) Occupational Structure : Ancient India was
predominantly an agricultural nation. The
economy was mainly rural economy.

Because of rich resources of the country, the
Mughals ruled the entire nation between the
16th and 19th centuries.

( 2 ) Agriculture : Indian agricultural sector was
prosperous and variety of crops were
grown. Rural areas were self-reliant.

The French, the Portuguese and the Dutch
also ruled over some parts of the country
for some time.

( 3 ) Industries : India was a prominent centre
of producing cotton, jute, muslin, wood,
idols-making, indigo, earthware, etc.

The British established their rule over India
almost from 1757 to 194 7.

( 4 ) Services : Ancient India had system of
minting metal coins. Because of unity
among people, trade in agricultural goods
and manufactured goods was prosperous.

East India Company established its rule for
the period from 1757 to 1858 and the British
established its government in India from 1858
till the midnight of 14th August, 1947.

( 5 ) Economic Prosperity : During the ume
of Maurya dynasty India was prosperous
with share of 25 % of the world wealthDuring the Mughal rule. India commanded
almost 90 % the wealth of southern Asiall
region. During the rule of Aurangzeb the
national income of India was 1o crore
pounds.

On 15th August India became an independent
country.
